The erratic nature of Putin’s movements over the past few weeks raises questions about his true location. While Putin’s movements remain uncertain, his close associates, including his girlfriend, have been seen in various locations, including Switzerland. This has led to speculation that she might be there to provide support during a critical time. Given the current climate of paranoia and speculation surrounding Putin’s activities, many are now questioning whether his girlfriend might be in Switzerland to give birth to their child. The erratic nature of Putin’s movements and the recent reports of him being in the Stockholm Archipelago raise further doubts about his true location.
